name: @pipeworx/mcp-dc-code

tools.name: dc_statute
tools.description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the District of Columbia Code (D.C. Code) — DC statutes — by citation. "22-2101" is murder in the first degree; "42-3505.01" covers eviction notice requirements. Accepts natural forms: "22-2101", "D.C. Code § 22-2101", "DC Code 22-2101". Returns the current statutory text, the official heading, disposition (in force / repealed / transferred / reserved), legislative History annotations, Prior Codifications, and Cross References. The DC Council's own GitHub source (DCCouncil/law-xml-codified, public domain) publishes the CURRENT codified text only — a prior (pre-amendment) version's exact text is not available through this source; this tool says so rather than guessing. Keyless. Use for "what does D.C. Code 22-2101 say" or to check a DC statute a case or lease relies on.

citation.description: Section citation, title-section, e.g. "22-2101" (murder in the first degree) or "42-3505.01" (eviction notice). The title may carry a letter suffix (e.g. "27A-101").

tools.name: dc_search
tools.description: Search the District of Columbia Code by TOPIC/keyword, and/or browse one TITLE's chapters and sections. Pass "query" to search official section headings (catchlines) — e.g. "landlord eviction notice", "concealed carry permit", "homicide" — across all 51+ titles or, with "title" also set, within just that title. Pass "title" alone (no query) to list every section under that D.C. Code title, acting as a chapter-list/browse tool. Matches official headings only (DC Council does not publish a full-text search over statutory body text). Call dc_statute with a result's citation for the full text. Keyless.

query.description: Topic or keywords to match against official section headings, e.g. "eviction notice".

title.description: A D.C. Code title number to filter to, or to list on its own (chapter-list mode), e.g. "22" or "27A".

limit.description: Max results. Default 10 (search) or 100 (title listing); max 50 (search) or 500 (title listing).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-dc-code forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the dc-code pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
